notes.title: A New 《Last Days Motel》 experience.
notes.content:
1 made the game suggestion system, now the player can play according to the game suggestion put forward by the character. 
2 modified defense mechanism, now in combat, defense skills can defend against any attack and special attack effect. 
3 the list tracking notepad has been made, and now the building materials needed for expansion can be edited and recorded in the list, and it is very convenient to view the synthetic items. 
4 optimized the operation interface of fitness machine and treatment bed. 
5 optimize the game scene

notes.title: LastDays hotel update.
notes.content:
·The dialogue part of the novice teaching can now be skipped. 
·Greatly reduce the difficulty , you can now get enough survival resources through daily cleaning. 
·Increased survival rewards. 
·Help and rescue system has been added in the game, when there is a shortage of materials, you can turn to other players for help. 
·A reputation system has been added to the game. 
·Added a new Arena play map. 


This update changes greatly, will empty the game data before, sorry about that.

notes.title: A New 《Last Days Motel》 experience.
notes.content:
·Novice teaching has been added so that players can better understand the structure of the game. 
·With the addition of a new passenger system, in-game currency output now depends on hotel fees. 
·Readjusted the distribution of resources, the pace of the game is lighter and more reasonable. 
·Some parts and building formulations have been readjusted. 
·Resolved the bug associated with the login game error. 

Due to the great changes in this update, this version will clear the previous account progress, please understand the inconvenience caused by this
